ASSEMBLY OF REAR AXLE HUB
(See page RA-6)

1. INSTALL BEARING
(a) Using SST, press in a new bearing outer race to the
axle carrier.
SST 09608-32010, 09608-35014 (09608-06180)

(b) Install a new bearing into the bearing outer race.
(c) Using snap ring pliers, install the snap ring.
